title: Ryanmae M. (People Leader; 'Passionate about designing cultures Employees Love') — 30 pages of Responsive Conf notes, Eric Ries in her top-4 speakers
summary: Ryanmae M. — People Leader focused on human-potential-through-innovation cultures — publishes a highest-engagement Responsive Conference recap (34 likes). Frames what made Responsive different — 'it wasn't 100% about AI and feeling like every session was a sales pitch' — and names Eric among the four speakers she's most reviewing her notes on Monday morning.
blockquote: You know an event is truly special when you come home with 30 pages of notes and ideas, along with some amazing new connections. Gianna Driver, Eric Ries, Tim Casasola, and Tony Levitan were just some of the speakers who have me reviewing my notes, inspired to act, and a little bit worried on how I can pick my "1 thing" to focus on Monday!
